svg.title: VarMQ topic fan-out with two subscribed workers
svg.desc: Two workers subscribe to one in-memory topic: sendEmail with concurrency 1 and updateStock with concurrency 2. Publish is called four times. Each payload is appended once to a shared log made of linked chunks (drawn with two slots per chunk) and every Publish wakes both workers' event loops. Each subscription reads the log through its own cursor and turns every payload into its own job, so both workers process all four payloads. updateStock is faster and its cursor runs ahead; the slow sendEmail cursor never blocks it. A payload stays in the log until every cursor has read it, and a chunk is freed by the garbage collector only once the slowest cursor has moved past it, so the middle chunk is kept while the email cursor still sits on it.
